card.name: Places where "clinical" comes next
card.fires_on: Fires on separators, short linking words or a split-off letter just before the word "clinical" or "clinic" would be expected. Seen in list menus, split-up German "klinische", and capitalized warning text.

modes.label: Before Clinical in a list
modes.description: A separator or split letter right before the word Clinical or its pieces in a menu or reference.
modes.example: Statistics<< |>> Clinical | Educational | Industrial | Professional items

modes.label: Linking words in caps warnings
modes.description: A small word in all-capital warning text where clinical or clinically could follow.
modes.example: LABORATORY<< AND>> SUPPORTIVE SERVICES MUST BE AVAILABLE FOR H

modes.label: Split clinical words
modes.description: The opening letter or piece of a word like clinical or klinische.

card.writes: It boosts clinical and clin- word starts in many languages as the next word.
card.plain: It fires where the next word is likely to be "clinical", such as before it in lists, titles and capitalized warnings.
